column1: Gives the visitor's browser a short Cache-Control lifetime on storefront pages that Magento itself declared full page cacheable, without shortening how long the shared cache keeps them. Intended for installations where the Varnish VCL cannot be edited, or where there is no Varnish at all.

column1: Value in seconds; typical values are 60, 120 and 300. It is capped at Magento's own full page cache lifetime, so it never outlives what the shared cache stores. This takes effect when Magento's built-in full page cache is the caching application, which is also the case where it is most needed. With Varnish selected instead, Magento's shipped VCL rewrites Cache-Control in vcl_deliver for every response that is not marked private, so nothing set here reaches the browser unless a CDN or a customised VCL passes the header through.
